evidence.claim: Peppermint oil improves global symptoms and abdominal pain in adults with IBS.
evidence.outcome_summary: Meta-analysis of 12 RCTs (835 patients): global symptoms RR 2.39 (NNT 3); abdominal pain RR 1.78 (NNT 4); adverse events not significantly increased.
evidence.note: EMA accepts well-established use of gastro-resistant capsules for this indication [6]. Evidence does not transfer to peppermint tea.
